svg.aria-label: Fleet blast radius in turbo tasks: an edit to the foundation lib re-runs all 30,708 tasks, and a breaking rev of it turns all 30,000 apps red, caught in 58.9s (batch) or 10.3s (sliced); a leaf-lib edit re-runs 100 of 30,708 tasks. The grids are schematic.

g.text: Blast radius: the tasks one lib edit re-runs
a breaking rev turns all 30,000 apps red:
every broken call site, with file and line
at 1,000 apps a leaf lib has 21 dependents
